address: The Warehouse@Hin Bus Depot, 125 Jalan Timah, George Town, 10150, Malaysia
bio: Inside a bus depot-turned art space sits this distressed building clad in corrugated metal panels. However, the interior is miles apart from the exterior, boasting a modern and sleek look. The menu changes monthly and showcases sophisticated European fare with subtle local twists. Every item served has been well thought out – the homemade sourdough with tomato butter is always a highlight. Even the palate cleanser surprises in pleasant ways....
